Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Initial commit: Add video composition tool with CLI theme options

This project is a Python video composition tool that generates MP4 videos from:
- Narration audio files
- Scene-by-scene scripts \(分镜脚本\)
- Scene images \(one per script line\)

Key features:
- Aliyun ASR for word-level timestamp extraction
- AI semantic matching \(Volcengine/DeepSeek\) for script alignment
- MoviePy video composition
- CLI theme/style options \(--theme, --style, --image-style\)
- Configurable scene count and auto-confirm

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
